messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: prompt-gateway v2 -> canary 10% at 2026-11-08T14:00:12Z. CI job #4921. Observability: brief spike in 5xx for /v1/prompt-route. link: https://observability.redwood.ai/d/abcd123/prompt-gateway

olivia: seeing 500s from EU prod on the new endpoint, some customers hitting timeouts. latency up ~400ms p95 on routed requests.

maya: paging oncall for infra. @samir you're up next. tagging incident channel.

incident-bot: Severity: S2 -> Notify on-call (maya). Auto-attach runbook: prompt-gateway-canary.md

maya: I'm on it. taking ownership. quick check: are we still serving old gateway behind fallback?

dave: yes, legacy prompt-gateway (v1) is healthy. traffic was supposed to automatically fallback but some sessions are sticky to v2.

samir: can we flip the feature flag to force all traffic to v1 immediately? need emergency cutover if errors keep rising.

maya: agreed. preparing to toggle ff. will coordinate with ops.

olivia: confirmed errors are concentrated on customers using long-context sessions (>8k). stacktraces point to kv cache miss causing retries and surge.

maya: executing emergency feature flag toggle now. command: `redwood-ctl flags set prompt_gateway_force_legacy_prod true --reason "canary 10% causing 5xx"`

deploy-bot: FF toggle request received by deploy-bot: user=maya, flag=prompt_gateway_force_legacy_prod, env=prod

maya: toggled. hitting the endpoint to verify routing: curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prompt-route -H "x-rw-session: test-stick"

samir: logs show session routing shifted to v1 for new sessions. old sticky sessions slowly drain.

olivia: error-rate dropped ~70% in last 90s. p95 latency returning to baseline. :white_check_mark:

maya: good. keeping flag on for now. starting rollback of v2 canary to avoid re-trigger. rollback plan: cancel canary route and redeploy a patched build next week. steps in runbook.

dave: I'm running a force-rollback: `k8s rollouts undo deployment/prompt-gateway-v2 --to-revision=0 --namespace=prod` (dry-run first).

deploy-bot: Rollout undo submitted by dave. Status: in progress.

incident-bot: Paging: handoff requested. maya -> samir for mitigation verification and customer comms.

maya: handing off to @samir. samir, can you take lead on external comms and postmortem? I'll stand by for infra work.

samir: taking lead. will compile impacted customers list (using billing tags and request ids). starting a short status email to support & sales. template: "We're investigating higher error rates for prompt routing; we've rolled traffic back to legacy gateway; no action required from customers; we'll follow up with RCA."

olivia: quick ask: can we confirm any L7 proxies cached the v2 endpoint DNS and might still route to it? seeing a few residual 504s.

maya: checking edge cache rules. If needed we can invalidate CDN keys for prompt-route. running: `cdnctl purge --path /v1/prompt-route --region eu`

dave: purge complete. residual 504s down to single-digit per minute.

samir: notifying sales/support channels. also creating a prioritized list of customers to DM (top 15 by usage).

incident-bot: Incident recorded: incident_id=INC-2026-1108-003. severity=S2. mitigation=feature_flag_forced_legacy + rollback_in_progress. owner=samir.

maya: confirming rollback succeeded: deployment status shows v2 replicas scaled to 0 and v1 at expected capacity.

deploy-bot: Canary route removed. v2 pods terminated. Traffic fully on v1.

olivia: monitoring for errors. will keep an eye for any data loss or user-visible degraded responses. so far metrics look stable.

samir: preparing customer-facing update: short note in support workspace and SOC.

maya: oncall handoff in 30m to anne for postmortem and follow-up. Anne will own the RCA and follow-up ops tasks.

anne: I'll pick this up. next steps I want: (1) reproduce locally with long-context sessions, (2) deeper KV cache instrumentation, (3) tighten canary gating for session stickiness. assigning owners and due dates in the postmortem doc.

samir: adding follow-ups: notify top impacted customers, update public status page with a short summary once final RCA done.

olivia: one more note — logging shows a rare serialization error in the v2 session sync codepath. we should include that in RCA.

maya: thanks team. current status: mitigated -> routing forced to legacy, v2 rollback done, customer comms in flight. incident remains open for RCA.

incident-bot: Incident auto-update: next check-in 15m. Please update thread when complete.

samir: will post the initial customer note in 10m and close the loop with oncall after handoff to anne.

anne: acknowledged. I will create the postmortem skeleton and ping infra/eng-ml for instrumentation work.

maya: closing hands here. passing pager off. thanks everyone for quick response. :pray:
